panels.description: Median seconds between a Needs-you verdict appearing and the command it led to, per Work Item, over the selected window. Cells with fewer than 5 distinct people are suppressed.

targets.expr: event.name:"needs_you.verdict_shown" OR event.name:"needs_you.command_sent" | stats by (work_item.id) count_uniq(actor) as actors, min(_time) as shown, max(_time) as decided | math decided - shown as seconds | filter actors:>=5 | stats median(seconds) as median_seconds

panels.title: Median time to resolve

panels.description: Mean number of command events a person sends before a Needs-you row settles, by path. Cells with fewer than 5 distinct people are suppressed.

targets.expr: event.name:"needs_you.command_sent" | stats by (path, tenant.id) count_uniq(actor) as actors, count() as commands | math commands / actors as tabs_per_decision | filter actors:>=5 | stats avg(tabs_per_decision) as tabs_per_decision

panels.title: Tabs per decision

panels.description: Undone commands as a share of sent commands. Cells with fewer than 5 distinct people are suppressed.

targets.expr: event.name:"needs_you.command_sent" OR event.name:"needs_you.undone" | stats by (tenant.id) count_uniq(actor) as actors, count(if(event.name:="needs_you.command_sent",1,0)) as sent, count(if(event.name:="needs_you.undone",1,0)) as undone | math undone / sent as undo_rate | filter actors:>=5

panels.title: Undo rate

panels.description: Work Items that returned to Needs you within 7 days as a share of resolved commands. Cells with fewer than 5 distinct people are suppressed.

targets.expr: event.name:"needs_you.command_sent" OR event.name:"work_item.back_in_needs_you" | stats by (tenant.id) count_uniq(actor) as actors, count(if(event.name:="needs_you.command_sent",1,0)) as resolved, count(if(event.name:="work_item.back_in_needs_you",1,0)) as returned | math returned / resolved as regret_rate | filter actors:>=5

panels.title: Regret rate

panels.description: Every Needs-you path with its verdicts, sent commands, undo rate and regret rate. Groups of fewer than 5 distinct people are suppressed by the transformation.

targets.expr: event.name:"needs_you.verdict_shown" OR event.name:"needs_you.command_sent" OR event.name:"needs_you.undone" OR event.name:"work_item.back_in_needs_you" | stats by (path, tenant.id) count_uniq(actor) as actors, count(if(event.name:="needs_you.verdict_shown",1,0)) as verdicts, count(if(event.name:="needs_you.command_sent",1,0)) as sent, count(if(event.name:="needs_you.undone",1,0)) as undone, count(if(event.name:="work_item.back_in_needs_you",1,0)) as returned

panels.title: Per path

panels.description: Rage clicks, dead clicks, U-turns and link-out bursts per screen. Groups of fewer than 5 distinct people are suppressed by the transformation.

targets.expr: event.name:"ui.rage_click" OR event.name:"ui.dead_click" OR event.name:"ui.u_turn" OR event.name:"ui.link_out_burst" | stats by (screen, event.name) count_uniq(actor) as actors, count() as events

panels.title: Confusion signals per screen

options.content: Queries are LogsQL against the VictoriaLogs datasource the `logsDatasource` variable selects, using the fields Unfold's insight export writes (`event.name`, `screen`, `tenant.id`, `actor`, `work_item.id`, `path`, `count`, `actors`, `day`). Stat panels and tables, not time series: each question has one current value. Cells and groups with fewer than 5 distinct people are suppressed, as the other DevEx dashboards do. These queries are proposed with RFC-0001 and may need adjusting to the homelab's VictoriaLogs field mapping.
